fragments.text: Source paraphrase: Wiremold organized six value streams by product family, each with a manager. Byrne and his team met those managers weekly. Each manager presented progress using five groups of forward-looking measures: customer service, productivity, quality, inventory turnover, and 5S/visual control. The discussion focused on current issues, with short speaking times. The passage also describes improvement targets and separate defect-reduction work; it does not explicitly say that the weekly meeting assigned actions, owners, due dates, or follow-up checks. The bounded subject for analysis is the weekly review practice as a whole, while its individual manager, meeting, reporting, and discussion components were already extracted in RUN-PILOT-003-SRC-005.
